rounds.claim: On 8 November 2026, the newest release of near-sdk, NEAR's Rust library for contracts, is in major version 5.
On 8 November 2026, the newest near-sdk release needs Rust 1.95 or newer.
near-sdk is released under the MIT or Apache 2.0 licence, at the user's choice.
On 8 November 2026, the newest release of near-api-js, NEAR's JavaScript library, is in major version 7.
On 8 November 2026, the newest near-api-js release needs Node.js 22 or newer.
near-api-js is a JavaScript library for talking to NEAR through its RPC API.
